units.source_text: 空蝉听到这话，心中想道：不知中将作何感想？

en.t: When Utsusemi heard these words, she thought to herself: what would the lieutenant think of this?

units.source_text: 只此一念，已使她觉得比死更苦，

en.t: That thought alone already made her feel a pain worse than death,

units.source_text: 淌了一身冷汗，心中懊恼万状。

en.t: and cold sweat ran over her whole body as her heart filled with unbearable remorse.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看她很可怜，

en.t: Prince Genji saw how pitiful she was,

units.source_text: 照例用他那一套不知哪里学得的情话来百般安慰，

en.t: and as usual he tried every kind of comfort with the romantic phrases he had somehow learned somewhere,

units.source_text: 力求感动她的心。

en.t: doing all he could to move her heart.

units.source_text: 空蝉却越发痛苦了，

en.t: But Utsusemi only grew more anguished,

units.source_text: 她说：“我觉得这不是事实，竟是做梦。

en.t: and she said, "I feel that this cannot be real, but must be a dream.

units.source_text: 你当我是个卑贱的人，

en.t: You take me for a lowly woman,

units.source_text: 所以这样作践我，教我怎不恨你？

en.t: and that is why you degrade me like this; how could I not hate you?

units.source_text: 我是有夫之妇，身份已定，

en.t: I am a married woman, and my position is already fixed,

units.source_text: 无可奈何的了。”

en.t: so there is nothing that can be done."

units.source_text: 她痛恨源氏公子的无理强求，

en.t: She bitterly hated Prince Genji's unreasonable coercion,

units.source_text: 说得他自觉惭愧。

en.t: and her words made him feel ashamed of himself.

units.source_text: 公子回答道：“我年幼无知，

en.t: The prince replied, "I am young and ignorant,

units.source_text: 不懂得什么叫作身份。

en.t: and I do not understand what people call status.

units.source_text: 你把我看作世间一般的轻薄少年，

en.t: You see me as one of the ordinary frivolous young men of the world,

units.source_text: 我很伤心。

en.t: and that deeply pains me.

units.source_text: 我从来不曾有过无理强求的暧昧行为，

en.t: I have never before behaved in any improper way by forcing myself on someone,

units.source_text: 你一定也知道的。

en.t: and surely you know that too.

units.source_text: 今天与你邂逅，

en.t: My chance meeting with you today

units.source_text: 大概是前世的宿缘了。

en.t: must surely be a bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 你如此疏远我，

en.t: Since you keep me at such a distance,

units.source_text: 我也怪你不得。

en.t: I cannot blame you.

units.source_text: 今天的事，我自己也觉得不可思议。”

en.t: Even I find what happened today beyond belief."

units.source_text: 他一本正经地说了许多话。

en.t: He said many such words with a perfectly serious air.

units.source_text: 然而空蝉对于这位盖世无双的美男子，

en.t: Yet toward this matchlessly handsome man,

units.source_text: 愈加不愿亲近了。

en.t: Utsusemi became even less willing to draw near.

units.source_text: 她想：“我不从他，

en.t: She thought, "If I do not yield to him,

units.source_text: 也许他会把我看作不解风情的粗蠢女子。

en.t: perhaps he will think of me as a crude and foolish woman who understands nothing of love.

units.source_text: 我就装作一个不值得恋爱的愚妇吧。”

en.t: Then I shall simply act like a stupid woman not worth loving."

units.source_text: 于是一直采取冷淡的态度。

en.t: So she continued to maintain a cold attitude.

units.source_text: 原来空蝉这个人的性情，温柔中含有刚强，

en.t: In truth, Utsusemi's nature combined gentleness with firmness,

units.source_text: 好似一枝细竹，

en.t: like a slender stalk of bamboo,

units.source_text: 看似欲折，却终于不断。

en.t: which seems about to break but in the end does not snap.

units.source_text: 此刻她心情愤激，

en.t: At that moment her feelings were angry and agitated,

units.source_text: 痛恨源氏公子的非礼行为，

en.t: and she bitterly hated Prince Genji's discourteous conduct,

units.source_text: 只管吞声饮泣，样子煞是可怜。

en.t: but she only stifled her voice and wept, looking truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 源氏公子虽然觉得对这女子不起，

en.t: Although Prince Genji felt he had wronged this woman,

units.source_text: 但是空空放过机会，又很可惜。

en.t: he also felt it would be a great pity to let the chance pass in vain.

units.source_text: 他看见空蝉始终没有回心转意，

en.t: When he saw that Utsusemi still had not changed her mind,

units.source_text: 便恨恨地说：“你为什么把我看作如此讨厌的人呢？

en.t: he said resentfully, "Why do you regard me as such a hateful person?

units.source_text: 请你想想：无意之中相逢，

en.t: Please think about it: when two people meet by chance,

units.source_text: 必有前生宿缘。

en.t: there must be a bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 你佯装作不解风情之人，

en.t: You pretend to be someone who understands nothing of romance,

units.source_text: 真教我痛苦难堪。”

en.t: and that truly makes me suffer unbearably."

units.source_text: 空蝉答道：“我这不幸之身，

en.t: Utsusemi answered, "If this unfortunate self of mine

units.source_text: 倘在未嫁时和你相逢，

en.t: had met you before I was married,

units.source_text: 结得露水因缘，

en.t: and had formed even a fleeting bond as brief as dew,

units.source_text: 也许还可凭仗分外的自豪之心，

en.t: perhaps I could have relied on an extraordinary sense of pride,

units.source_text: 希望或有永久承宠之机会，

en.t: hoping that there might one day be a chance to enjoy your lasting favor,

units.source_text: 借此聊以自慰。

en.t: and used that thought to comfort myself a little.

units.source_text: 如今我乃有夫之妇，

en.t: But now I am a married woman,

units.source_text: 和你结了这无凭春梦似的刹那因缘，

en.t: and the momentary bond I have formed with you is as groundless as a spring dream,

units.source_text: 真教我寸心迷乱，不知所云。

en.t: truly leaving my heart confused and my words beyond my own understanding.

units.source_text: 现在事已如此，

en.t: Now that things have come to this,

units.source_text: 但望切勿将此事泄露于人！”

en.t: I only beg you never to reveal this matter to anyone!"

units.source_text: 她那忧心忡忡的神色，

en.t: Her deeply anxious expression

units.source_text: 使人觉得这真是合理之言。

en.t: made one feel that her words were truly reasonable.

units.source_text: 源氏公子郑重地向她保证，

en.t: Prince Genji solemnly gave her his assurance,

units.source_text: 讲了许多安慰的话。

en.t: and spoke many words of comfort.
